rationale: At step 40 the dense coreference verifier increased by 0.016304 while the strict coreference step-1 action match remained 0/8; the RAG-miss category decreased by 0.028986. This arm tests whether focused GRPO can change the actual state-conditioned action without letting the mixed objective dilute it.

confirmation.trigger: Run only if the seed-42 development gate passes.
confirmation.success_rule: Across locked seeds, the mean paired test action-match delta is positive with an entity-clustered 95% interval excluding zero; direct RAG, general answer, and memory-end verifier regressions must each be no worse than 0.02.

claim_boundary: A passing screen is evidence for GRPO growth on resolvable coreference routing only. It does not establish improvement on the mixed stateful benchmark or production traffic.
